The '''Bassel system''' was located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the substance known as [[Bassel sea salt]].<ref name="Science">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Bassel sea salt]]|system=Bassel [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bassel [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
